xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
1.The unaudited financial results have been prepared in accordance with Indian Accounting Standards (Ind-AS) as prescribed under Section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013, as amended ('the Act") read with relevant rules issued thereunder and other accounting principles generally accepted in India. The financial results of Tracxn Technologies Limited ("the Company"), will be available on the Company's website (www.tracxn.com), on the website of NSE (www.nseindia.com) and BSE (www.bseindia.com).

2.The statement of unaudited financial results for the quarter and six months period ended September 30, 2026 have been reviewed by the Audit Committee in their meeting on November 04, 2026 and approved by the Board of Directors in their meeting held on November 04, 2026. These unaudited financial results have been subjected to limited review by statutory auditors of the Company.

3.On November 21, 2025, the Government of India notified the four Labour Codes - the Code on Wages, 2019, the Industrial Relations Code, 2020, the Code on Social Security, 2020, and the Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020 - consolidating twenty-nine existing labor laws. The Ministry of Labour & Employment published draft Central Rules and FAQs to facilitate assessment of the financial impact due to changes in regulations. Based on the best information available as at year ended March 31, 2026, and understanding of the FAQ issued by The Ministry of Labour & Employment and guidance issued by The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India, the Company assessed and disclosed the incremental impact of the Labour Codes on the employee benefit expenses. The Company presented such incremental impact as “Exceptional items” in the statement of audited financial statements for year ended March 31, 2026. The incremental impact consisting of gratuity of Rs. 102.50 Lakhs and long-term compensated absences of Rs. 27.83 Lakhs primarily arises due to change in definition of wages.

As at September 30, 2026, the Company continues to monitor the finalisation of Central/ State Rules and clarifications from the Government in this regard and would provide appropriate accounting effect on the basis of such developments as needed.

4.The Company has, at various grant dates issued employee stock options to its employees at an exercise price equal to the face value of the Company's share, which were approved by the Nomination and Remuneration Committee and the Board of Directors. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, an amount of Rs. 58.32 Lakhs (June 30, 2026: Rs.57.60 Lakhs) has been recorded as employee stock option expense based on requirements in Ind AS 102,' Share-based payments'. The ESOPs granted and outstanding as at September 30, 2026, aggregates to 3,735,686 (June 30, 2026: 3,696,972). The Company has allotted 218,699 equity shares to the employees on exercise under ESOP Scheme for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.

5.The Company's operations relate to only one reportable segment viz Platform Subscription. Accordingly, no separate disclosure of segment information is required.

6.The Company does not have any subsidiary / associate / joint venture company(ies).

7.Previous period/ year's figures have been regrouped/ reclassified, wherever necessary to conform to the current period classification.

8.The financial information for the quarter ended September 30, 2025, the year ended March 31, 2026, and the quarter ended June 30, 2026, was reviewed or audited by a predecessor auditor. Their reports, dated November
05, 2025, May 25, 2026, and August 05, 2026, respectively, expressed unmodified conclusions/opinions on those statements.
